hypothesis: Complete allowed pair families from each bare reference supply direct ground and excited-state core-valence couplings absent in the earlier selective 68-CSF family. The same radial pool and Hamiltonian permit distinguishing balanced-family differential shifts from a larger radial cutoff effect. Angular support is not assumed to predict radial matrix elements or the sign of a transition shift.
scope: Fixed native005 converged MCDHF orbitals: nested balanced-family fixed-orbital RCI discriminator only; not expanded-family MCDHF stationarity, not complete CV, not a production or experimental certification.

operators: public Dirac-Coulomb plus complete static Gaunt and retardation Breit

state_and_observable_contract.primary_binding: Full symmetry-resolved maximum squared signed-overlap assignment from previous DC all-root eigenvectors; current static states bound through complete current DC-to-static assignment. Independently compare adjacent static assignment and bare maximum-overlap state.
state_and_observable_contract.degenerate_subspace: Archive all same-J/parity roots and signed CI coefficients; target flagged ambiguous for nearest same-symmetry gap <=1e-8 Ha; no isolated-column claim in degenerate cluster.
state_and_observable_contract.energy_reference: Report tracked6s referenced transitions separately from actual finite-H ground referenced excitations; report full actual ground family identity.
observables: Absolute lower and upper energies and their previous/bare increments
Transition increments against identical preceding and bare DC/static operators
Full bare and previous signed-state spectral distributions and moment identities
NIST nominal energy residuals and unchanged 1% nominal comparison; diagnostic not certified even if comparison passes
state_and_observable_contract.experimental_identity: Original005 saved result rows and contract; no live experimental update or fitting

distinguishing_outcomes: Ground and upper shifts similar: previous selective-core space was unbalanced
Transition gap improves: these measured same-pool core families are supported next-MCDHF candidates
Transition gap worsens or bindings mix: missing additional correlation/orbital response remains; no inferred QED cure
Zero or cancellation-sized radial coupling: angular support alone is insufficient

resource_contract.scope: Resource estimates are preflight evidence, observed elapsed times under machine load are not controlled speedups. Dense all-CSF arrays retained as forensic evidence fit this small diagnostic.

stopping_condition: Stop on unchanged numerical gate failure, source/input identity mismatch, complete determinant resource cap breach, 4 GiB limit, or 900 second timeout; retain completed and failed evidence; do not silently shrink any family or change physics, weights, state identity or thresholds.
efficiency_rationale: Cheap discriminating same24 radial pool: no bigger n/l cutoff or repeated orbital optimization. Complete family/angular structure reused by Atomx public consumers. This fixed-orbital test can prioritize a physically balanced subsequent MCDHF model but cannot certify it.
outputs: verification.json independent numerical and archival gates
per-stage complete matrices, signed all-root eigenvectors, target_binding, overlaps and results
